comment: Bluetooth LE 1 Mb/s advertising channel (LE 1M uncoded PHY): GFSK, BT 0.5, modulation index 0.5, a 1 the higher frequency. Received packet by packet: the burst step cuts the capture into its packets and every packet is demodulated on its own. In each, the access address is found in the discriminator's output (the preamble step, its waveform made by this profile's own transmit side), which places the bit timing and takes off the carrier offset (a level there: up to the 150 kHz the standard allows); the delimiter then finds the access address among the bits, the marker step strips and, transmitting, attaches it, then the PDU header, payload and CRC-24, whitened from the header on with the channel's sequence, every field least significant bit first. Out come the advertising PDU payloads whose CRC checks, one output per packet. The capture is one channel at `sps` samples per bit (4 MS/s: 4)
ref: Bluetooth Core 6.0 Vol 6 Part A 3, Part B 2.1, 3.1, 3.2

channel.comment: advertising channel index (37, 38, 39): seeds the whitening
